messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). p99=2.8s (SLO 2.0s). streaming stall events increasing. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234 | triggered: pipeline-latency-detector
pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: eng-oncall-jamie, sre-maya — incident created and page dispatched :rotating_light:
eng-oncall-jamie: ack — joining. starting quick triage. assigning roles: raj runtime, rohit infra, maya SRE, ana support.
eng-oncall-jamie: first q: global or regional? any recent deploys/rollouts in us-west-2?
platform-rohit: looks regional — us-west-2 only. autoscaler queue depth +87% on gen-pool-2, pod CPU ~95%. errors: small bump in 5xx (~1.2% -> 3.7%). metrics: p95=420ms, p99=2800ms.
eng-runtime-raj: any deploys? I see a canary for kvcache/quantize rolled at 03:10 UTC to 10% of traffic in us-west-2 (tag v2026-03-14-kvcache).
product-lex: that canary is the quantization + kvcache config change we ran for latency cost experiment. target was 10% non-prod traffic but looks like routing spilled to prod for some model variants.
eng-oncall-jamie: ok. steps: 1) check K/V cache miss rate + eviction, 2) confirm streaming clients errors, 3) decide rollback / fallback. raj, can you paste queries for kvcache?
eng-runtime-raj: running quick query. snippet:
```
SELECT time, kv_miss_rate, evictions FROM runtime.kvcache WHERE region='us-west-2' AND model LIKE '%llama%' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 30;
-- results: kv_miss_rate spiked from 2% -> 18% at 03:12 UTC, evictions 0.9k/min -> 7.6k/min
```
eng-runtime-raj: also seeing increased per-token generation stalls for streaming connections: many small batches, long backend waits (~200-600ms) between tokens.
support-ana: support seeing multiple tickets: ENT-4391, ENT-4392, PRO-22 — customers report streaming timeouts and degraded interactive UX since ~03:15 UTC. I'll escalate severity and notify account reps.
eng-oncall-jamie: mitigation plan: A) rollback canary to remove quantize+kv change, B) scale up gen-pool in us-west-2 by +4 nodes, C) enable model-variant fallback to smaller model for affected routes. doing A and B now.
platform-rohit: scaling GPU pool +4 nodes (requested at 03:28). cloud-cli output: `scale-group gen-pool-2 --count +4` -> in-progress. expected capacity in ~4m.
eng-oncall-jamie: rolling back canary  v2026-03-14-kvcache -> triggering deploybot rollback. deploybot: rollback started, targeting canary traffic.
incident-bot: DeployBot: rollback job 98765 submitted by eng-oncall-jamie. status: running.
eng-runtime-raj: while rollback is in flight, I can enable a routing fallback for streaming endpoints to model small-llama-compat (lower memory, proven stable). patching routing table now:
```
PATCH /routing/config
{ "route": "/v1/generate/stream", "fallback_model": "small-llama-compat", "max_tokens": 1024 }
```
platform-rohit: routing change applied to us-west-2 edge nodes.
eng-oncall-jamie: can everyone watch p95/p99 and kv miss rate for next 10 minutes. share any anomalies.
eng-runtime-raj: preliminary: after rollback trigger + routing fallback, kv_miss_rate trending down (was 18% -> 6% in last 60s). p99 improved from 2.8s -> 1.9s on fallback for sampled traffic.
sre-maya: good progress. I'll take 30m watch. create incident ticket and assign follow-ups: bake better canary isolation, add guardrail for kvcache rollouts, add alert for cache-eviction-rate > 5%/min.
support-ana: I'll send status update to affected customers: ETA for full resolution ~15-30m, explaining temporary fallback & rollback.
eng-oncall-jamie: oncall handoff: I'll stay until state stabilizes, then hand to sre-maya at 04:00 UTC.
product-lex: note for postmortem: this looks like interaction between quantization + new kv eviction policy; both need offline eval before rollout.
eng-runtime-raj: quick log excerpt showing stalled streams:
```
[03:16:12] stream_conn=sd-12 token_index=34 wait_ms=502
[03:16:13] stream_conn=sd-12 token_index=35 wait_ms=612 
[03:16:14] stream_conn=sd-45 generation_error=timeout_retriable
```
eng-oncall-jamie: thanks. monitoring shows p95=380ms, p99=1.2s for routes on fallback. errors back to baseline. marking incident state: partial mitigation in place.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-14-4880012345 severity downgraded to P2 — mitigation active.
sre-maya: I'll keep an eye for tail latency spikes for next 60m and own the follow-up. please file postmortem with timeline and impact numbers.
support-ana: update sent to customers and CS reps. they'll reopen if they still see issues.
eng-oncall-jamie: final: track the rollback job completion and model canary flags. if rollback fails, we escalate to full traffic block. otherwise we monitor and close in 60m. thanks team :thumbsup:
